label: measured
note: The statements a data person needs to find and verify the five keys (a cik, b loc, c FEMA state, d station, e SIC) on the same cached views were run one at a time through the gateway (127.0.0.1:8803) after the ablation runs finished, each result read before the next statement was chosen. Measured: the statements, their gateway elapsed_ms, and the decisions taken. The session time (first step to the end of the last statement) is reported for completeness but is NOT a measure of how long a person would take: the SQL was not typed from scratch (each statement is a gateway reader template: DESCRIBE, SELECT ... LIMIT 5, distinct counts, the match-rate count and its orphans, or a named join-map statement where the counted side needs a transform the generic statement does not apply), so the time to write that SQL and to read results at human speed is not measured. Steps 8, 9, 11, 23, 28 and 29 use the named join-map statements because the comparison needs LPAD or SUBSTR on the right-hand side, a three-view union or a per-utility row count.

params.what: zetaris/manifest.json: the registered views and their sources

steps.result: 10 sources; candidate views: cw.seed_submissions_snapshot (43 utilities), cw.frames_<tag>_<period> (SEC revenue), cw.fema_declarations_dr_2025q1, cw.utility_states, cw.states, cw.seed_stations, cw.stations, cw.sic_codes
steps.decision: start with the utility list (snapshot) and one revenue view

steps.result: cik10, name, ticker, sic, hq_state, snapshot_at (all strings)
steps.decision: candidate keys: cik10 (to revenue), sic (to the SIC reference), hq_state (to the frames loc)

steps.result: cik10 is a 10-character zero-padded string; hq_state two letters; sic four digits
43 rows, 43 distinct cik10, no nulls
steps.decision: cik10 is the utility's primary key

steps.result: cik is a bigint; loc a string
cik is an unpadded integer (2098); loc is 'US-CT' style; the view holds every SEC filer, not just utilities
steps.decision: first try: join the snapshot's cik10 to the frames cik as they are

steps.result: 0 of 43 utilities match: the frames cik is not zero-padded
steps.decision: pad the frames cik to 10 digits (LPAD) and count the utilities found under any of the three revenue tags (one statement over the three frames views)

steps.result: 42 of 43 utilities found once the frames cik is padded
steps.decision: key a (cik, LPAD to 10) VERIFIED at 0.977; look at the one orphan

steps.result: IDACORP has no CY2025Q1 fact under any of the three tags
steps.decision: keep the orphan as a named gap, not a key failure

params.what: frames loc format: 'US-' plus the two-letter state (seen in the sample rows); the snapshot holds the business-address state hq_state

steps.decision: strip 'US-' (SUBSTR from 4, length 2) and compare with hq_state for the matched utilities

steps.result: 42 of 42 frames utilities report the same state as their business address
steps.decision: key b (loc SUBSTR(4,2) to hq_state) VERIFIED at 1.000

steps.result: state (two letters), fips_state_code (string), disaster_number
steps.decision: join on state; FIPS as a cross-check against the state reference

steps.result: one row per designated county; state two letters; fips_state_code two digits
steps.decision: count distinct states (not rows) when matching

steps.result: cik (string), state: one row per utility and served state
steps.decision: match the declared states against the served states

steps.result: 7 of 8 declared states are served by a seed utility
steps.decision: key c is PARTIAL (0.875); list the orphan

steps.result: AK is the orphan: no seed utility serves Alaska
steps.decision: keep AK as the named orphan of a PARTIAL key

steps.result: 8 of 8 declared FIPS state codes are in the state reference
steps.decision: the state reference (FIPS) is the governed parent of a declaration; VERIFIED 1.000

steps.result: code, name, fips (the reference used in step 17; described after the fact)
id, state, name: the 56 stations of the seed utilities
id, state, name, latitude, longitude: the GHCN station inventory
steps.decision: join on the 11-character station id

steps.result: ids are 11 characters; non-US stations have a blank state
steps.decision: match the seed ids against the inventory ids as they are (identity)

steps.result: 56 of 56 seed station ids are in the inventory
steps.decision: key d (station id) VERIFIED at 1.000; check the seed's state against the inventory's state too

steps.result: 56 of 56 match, and the state agrees for all 56
code (string), description, division, major group
steps.decision: join the snapshot's sic to code

steps.result: codes are four-character zero-padded strings, like the snapshot's sic
steps.decision: identity, no transform

steps.result: 3 of 4 distinct SIC codes found (0.750 by codes)
steps.decision: a code count misreads an attribute key: count utilities (rows) instead

steps.result: 4900 is the code the reference lacks
steps.decision: find which utilities carry 4900 and count matched utilities

steps.result: 42 of 43 utilities carry a SIC code the reference holds (3 of 4 distinct codes)
steps.decision: key e (SIC) VERIFIED at 0.977 by utility rows, the code reading beside it

steps.result: MGE Energy (0001161728) carries 4900, absent from the reference
steps.decision: keep MGE as the named orphan

keys.key: a: frames cik (LPAD 10) to submissions cik10
b: frames loc (SUBSTR 4,2) to submissions business state
c: FEMA state to served state (utility_states)
c (reference): FEMA FIPS state code to the state reference
d: seed station id to the GHCN inventory id
e: submissions SIC to the SIC reference (utility rows; 3 of 4 codes)
